data.narrative:
Skyryse, a Series C-stage aerospace company that has raised $500M+, is valued at $1.15B post-money. The valuation analysis references a peer universe of 6 private companies in Space & Aerospace at same or adjacent stages, alongside 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) representing the sector's public trading multiples.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $1.1B last post-money valuation, implying $2.0B. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector comps—including Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Impulse Space ($4.3B, Series D), Apex Space ($2.3B, Series D), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B, Series D), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), and one unnamed peer—yields a median of $2.1B, with a range spanning $1.3B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 24.4x P/S median across the five public tickers, Skyryse's revenue is not disclosed.

Triangulation across the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $1.7B (low) to $2.5B (high), with a median of $2.1B. The current $1.15B valuation sits materially below this range. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory relative to peers, competitive positioning within a wide valuation dispersion ($1.3B–$8.0B), and the impact of undisclosed product-stage or customer-concentration factors on investor appetite at Series C+ stages.
